Auckland Matariki Open 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.name: Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, den nordligaste kubtävlingen i Sverige någonsin!

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

**OBS:** Du behöver bara befinna dig i tävlingslokalen när de grenar du själv ska tävla i går av stapeln. Check-in kan genomföras när som helst under tävlingshelgen, så du behöver ej infinna dig på fredag kväll enbart för detta.

-----

Welcome to Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, the northernmost competition in Sweden ever!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.'

**N.B.:** You only need to be in the competition venue when the events you are going to compete in take place. Check-in can be done at any time during the competition weekend, so you don't have to show up on Friday night just for this.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2024
items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southeast [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2024. Residents of the following states are eligible for the title of Southeast Champion:

* **Alabama**
* **Florida**
* **Georgia**
* **North Carolina**
* **South Carolina**
* **Tennessee**

All competitors **must** read the **"Important Information/FAQ"** tab prior to registering.

items.name: PBQ at MSU 2024
items.information:
Please note: The only events at this competition are 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded. These events tend to be very boring for spectators, and we will not be having the normal speedsolving events that you're used to. If you are looking to compete in a speedsolving competition, considering registering for [Michigan Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MichiganChampionship2024), which is on June 29-30.
